roiMeaning: Native encoded-video rectangle [left,top,width,height]. Contains the athlete and bench within the stage; excludes the caption around y648 and all player controls below y678. Same rectangle in light and dark recordings.
brightPixelRule: R + G + B >= 240 in ffmpeg-decoded RGB24 (mean channel value >=80)
gate: Fail if any encoded frame overlapping the declared review range has bright coverage outside [0.04,0.20], or any encoded presentation interval in that range exceeds0.08s. Never average away an isolated failed frame. Decode every encoded frame with no time resampling or scaling.

calibration.source: Actual CI V2 light/dark continuous-playback WebMs, run37361829827, reviewed range[0.88,8.52).
calibration.justification: The lower threshold is below half the smallest observed visible-athlete count yet far above the observed blank value. The upper threshold is over twice the largest normal count and rejects a bright page/stage flash. Fixed values are shared before and after the player repair. A new layout or different encoded dimensions is unsupported and must fail closed, not silently move the ROI or recalibrate.

limitations: This checks encoded stage-content continuity over a caller-declared range, not pose correctness, cue timing, anatomical quality, or a completed sequence.
At25fps a recording cannot show a blank that occurs entirely between sampled frames. Passing means no failing encoded frame in the declared interval, not proof of every browser paint.
Native visual review and independent complete-cycle/timing evidence remain required.
